title: Verify BNB robustness with discovered RSI parameters (rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168)
objective: Verify that the discovered BNB-specific parameters (rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168) produce consistent results across different WFA windows to confirm robustness vs overfitting
hypothesis: The BNB-specific parameters (rsi_oversold=25, rsi_overbought=60, hold_bars=168) will maintain Sharpe > 0.8 and Drawdown < 15% across at least 70% of WFA windows, demonstrating genuine robustness rather than single-window overfitting
strategy_rationale: Prior run showed these parameters achieved 1.275 OOS Sharpe (+195% vs generic params). This follow-up tests whether that result was a genuine edge or lucky window selection by running extended WFA with same parameters but different train/test splits. The 168 hold_bars (7 days) indicates longer-term mean reversion works better for BNB's exchange token volatility profile.
instrument_selection_rule: Single asset: BNB/USDT - same asset as prior discovery run
dataset_requirements: BNB/USDT 1h OHLCV from Binance, minimum 3 years history for robust WFA

historical_depth_requirement.justification: Multi-year crypto history required for reliable WFA; the BNB deep dataset has 43,789 1h bars which is the maximum realistic Binance history for this pair. Short windows not justified as BNB is a liquid top-10 asset.

source_plan.selection_reason: BNB deep dataset already exists locally at workspace/data/binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv; verified clean with 43,789 rows

scope_selection_rationale: BNB is the exact asset where parameters were discovered. Testing on same asset to verify robustness - if parameters work across multiple train/test splits on BNB, it suggests genuine edge rather than overfitting. Using same deep dataset but different WFA window configurations to stress-test the parameters.

data_acquisition.reason: binance_bnbusdt_1h_deep.csv already exists with 43,789 rows of clean 1h data

implementation_steps: 1. Create WFA config for BNB robustness test with fixed discovered parameters
2. Configure WFA to use discovered parameters as fixed (not optimized) to test robustness
3. Run WFA with longer training window (6 months) and standard testing (1 month) to increase statistical confidence
4. Evaluate window-by-window metrics to check consistency
5. Compare % of positive Sharpe windows vs prior run

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA completes with at least 30 windows and 200 total trades

fallback_if_blocked: If WFA fails, run simplified backtest on same data to verify parameter validity
If data unavailable, fetch fresh BNB 1h from Binance API
notes: Key difference from prior run: This run uses FIXED parameters (no optimization) to test robustness. Prior run optimized to find these parameters - this run verifies they hold across multiple train/test splits.
The 70% positive Sharpe window threshold is critical - if parameters only work on the single optimized window, that's overfitting. Genuine edges should work across multiple windows.
